reading.body:
Tome pairs an AI presentation and storytelling product with a customer-intelligence MCP that segments customers and predicts which to prioritize for sales.

The product note lists AI storytelling, presentation generation, narrative design, and creative IP, which are generative tasks requiring model inference. The MCP, by contrast, is analytical: it segments customer data and ranks customers for sales focus. One company therefore spans two distinct AI workloads, generation and prediction.

The data does not include compute, power, or building figures, so it cannot show grid impact or scaling constraints. It also omits model size, user counts, or revenue, so the operational footprint of either workload is unknown.
